note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.sel.beam module functions. 3DEC 7.0-only module: the legacy SEL (structural element) scripting interface. Absent from 3DEC 9.x, where structural elements are accessed through itasca.structure instead. All signatures and descriptions were captured from live 3DEC 7.00 (Release 161) __doc__ introspection.

methods.name: area
methods.description: Get the cross-section area of a beam.

methods.name: collection
methods.description: Get the collection ID of a given beam.

methods.name: dir
methods.description: Get the beam beam direction (vector).

methods.name: dir_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the beam beam direction.

methods.name: dir_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the beam beam direction.

methods.name: dir_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the beam beam direction.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the beam extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: force_axial
methods.description: Get the axial force on the beam.

methods.name: force_thermal
methods.description: Get the themral force on a beam.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the beam group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: beam.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the beam. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this beam is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the beam id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: beam.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the beam is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Get a beam index (offset).

methods.name: length
methods.description: Get the length of the beam element.

methods.name: matnum
methods.description: Get the material number for a beam element.

methods.name: node
methods.description: Get a node of a beam element.

methods.name: normal_stiffness
methods.description: Get the normal stiffness (force/displacement) of the interface between the beam element and the rock/soil.

methods.name: normal_strength
methods.description: Get the normal (tensile) strength of the interface between the beam element and the rock/soil. Units are force.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the beam beam position (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the beam beam position.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the beam beam position.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the beam beam position.

methods.name: set_area
methods.description: Set the cross-section area of a beam.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the beam extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: beam.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the beam group name in a given slot.

methods.name: shear_cohesion
methods.description: Get the cohesion at the interface of the beam element and the rock/soil.

methods.name: shear_friction
methods.description: Get the friction angle (in degrees) of the interface of the beam element and the soil/rock.

methods.name: shear_stiffness
methods.description: Get the shear stiffness (Force / displacement) at the interface between the beam element and the rock/soil.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Get the beam element state, by indicator.

methods.name: strain_axial
methods.description: Get the axial strain on the beam.

methods.name: stress_axial
methods.description: Get the axial stress on the beam.

methods.name: thermalexp
methods.description: Get the thermal expansion coefficient of a beam element.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this beam is live.

methods.name: young
methods.description: Get the Young's modulus of a beam element.
